key_insight: LeanSide lets students write natural-language proofs while a formally verified Lean backend checks reasoning and turns verifier feedback back into readable guidance.
engineering_relevance: The system shows how to combine LLM-style co-reasoning with proof-assistant verification to support trustworthy human-AI tools for math education and other deductive workflows.
method: Auto-formalizes student-written proof steps into Lean for machine checking.
Informalizes verifier output into understandable, user-level feedback.
Studies the interface via classroom deployment to see what helps or blocks student progress.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports user studies through classroom deployment and analysis of which system properties helped students make progress or caused them to get stuck.
watch_item: Natural-language-to-formal translation can still misalign with student intent, so granularity and feedback mapping need careful design to avoid confusion or dead ends.
paper_title: LeanSide: A Formally Verified Co-Reasoning System for Natural-language Proofs
